desc: Ideate the Segment Tree approach with survivor lists.
Take two sorted lists (left, right) where all elements in left < all in right.
Iterate right (descending) and match with left (descending) if $l \le r/2$.
Return sorted list of unmatched elements.
Build the Segment Tree in $O(N \log N)$.
Implement the query function to merge $O(\log N)$ nodes and count pairs.
Read input, process queries, and print results.
Optimize if necessary (e.g., handle large survivor lists efficiently).
